steps.instruction: Two Avatars, one battlefield. Bring the enemy Avatar's Health to zero before yours falls.
Your army stands in three lanes. FRONT grants +1 Attack. MIDDLE grants +1 Health. BACK is where Strategists and Perfects draw you an extra card.
Tap a lane to open it, then pick up to three cards for that lane. Tap a deployed card to take it back - nothing is locked until you start the battle.
Every card costs Resource to deploy. Spend what you like now - leftover Resource is kept for reinforcements later.
Cards sharing an affinity strengthen the whole squad. Two matching gives a bonus, three gives more. Watch this line as you build.
When your three lanes are set, start the battle. Your formation locks at that moment.
The lanes now clash on their own. A lane with no defenders left lets damage through to the Avatar behind it.
Energy builds every clash. Spend it on Avatar spells - burn a lane, heal your own, or strike the enemy Avatar directly.
At Clash 4 and Clash 8 your reserves return. Spend leftover Resource to fill any lane that has lost a card.
If neither Avatar falls within twelve clashes, whoever holds the greater share of their Health wins. Stalling is not a strategy.
